P.name: Living Battery
P.description:
{{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zeri''' generates 1 charge for every 40 units she travels by any means and 10 charge every time she casts ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}}'', up to a maximum of 100 charge. Her {{tip|basic attacks}} consume charge to deal '''modified''' damage.
'''Zeri''' gains maximum charge when the game starts and upon [[respawn]]ing.
P.description2: {{tip|Basic Attack|{{sbc|Basic Attack:}}}} '''Zeri''' zaps the target, dealing {{as|{{pp|10+(15/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 3% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}, applying {{tip|spell effects}} as {{tip|spell damage}}, triggering on-cast effects and {{ccs|executing|magic}} the target if they are below {{pp|70 + (160-70)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=hp}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}} {{sti|{{as|health}}}}. This cannot {{tip|critically strike}} and does not apply nor trigger {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
P.description3: At full charge, '''Zeri's''' next attack is empowered to consume all charge to deal {{as|{{pp|75 + (160-75)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 110% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{pp|1 + (11-1)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|magic damage}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Burst Fire
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' fires a burst of 7 rounds in the target direction over the cast time, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.
Q.leveling:
{{st|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|22 to 38}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102 to 110}}% AD)}}|Total Critical Strike Damage|{{ap|22*{{#var:crit}} to 38*{{#var:crit}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102*{{#var:crit}} to 110*{{#var:crit}}}}% AD)}}|Total Infinity Edge Damage|{{ap|22*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}}) to 38*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}}) to 110*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})}}% AD)}}}}
{{st|Physical Damage per Hit|{{ap|22/7 to 38/7|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102/7 to 110/7|round=2}}% AD)}}|Critical Strike per Hit|{{ap|22*{{#var:crit}}/7 to 38*{{#var:crit}}/7|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102*{{#var:crit}}/7 to 110*{{#var:crit}}/7|round=2}}% AD)}}|Infinity Edge Damage per Hit|{{ap|22*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/7 to 38*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/7|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|102*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/7 to 110*({{#var:crit}}+{{#var:ie_mod}})/7|round=2}}% AD)}}}}
Q.description2: ''Burst Fire's'' projectile is treated as a {{tip|basic attack}}: it hits any enemy unit a typical basic attack can; deals {{tip|basic damage}}; can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Zeri|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage; and applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects to the first enemy hit. ''Burst Fire's'' {{sti|cooldown}} and cast time are reduced with {{sti|{{as|attack speed}}}}, with the maximum of {{as|{{fd|1.5}}|attack speed}} attacks per second. {{#expr: 0.6 * 100 }}% of {{as|attack speed}} in excess of the cap is converted into {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}.
Q.description3: '''''Zeri''' can cast Burst Fire even while {{tip|silence|silenced}}.''

W.name: Ultrashock Laser
W.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' fires an electric pulse in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit and {{tip|slows}} them for 2 seconds.

If the pulse hits [[terrain]], it transforms into a laser in a line that grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|1.75}} seconds and fires after {{fd|0.85}} seconds, applying the same effects to enemies hit and {{tip|critical strike|critically striking}} for {{as|{{critical damage|150|50}}|critical damage}} damage against {{tip|champions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.

E.name: Spark Surge
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction. She will dash farther across [[terrain]] if ''Spark Surge'' was cast within 50 units of any, gaining {{tip|unobstructed vision}} of the surrounding 800 units and {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself while there are enemy champions within 1500 units of her.
E.description2: Afterwards, she gains ''Lightning Rounds'' for 5 seconds, empowering ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{critical damage|0 to 100|critScaling=true}}, and pierce through enemies. Targets after the first take modified damage which does not apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects or {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} nor trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects, but is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
E.leveling2:
{{st|{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}} Bonus Magic Damage|{{ap|22 to 30}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}}}
{{st|{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}} Secondary Target Damage|{{ap|80 to 100}}%}}
E.description3: ''Spark Surge's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by {{fd|0.5}} seconds whenever '''Zeri''' hits at least one enemy with a ''{{ai|Basic Attack 2|Zeri|charged}}'' basic attack or ''{{ai|Burst Fire|Zeri}}'', increased to {{fd|1.5}} seconds if the latter {{tip|critical strike|critically strikes}}.
E.description4: ''Spark Surge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Zeri's''' basic attack timer and {{ais|Burst Fire|Zeri}} cooldown. {{ai|Ultrashock Laser|Zeri}} and {{ai|Lightning Crash|Zeri}} can be cast during the dash.''

R.name: Lightning Crash
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zeri''' discharges an electric nova that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies. If this hits at least one enemy champion, she enters ''Overcharged'' for 5 seconds. Hitting an enemy champion with an ability or ''{{ai|Living Battery|Zeri|charged}}'' attack will extend the duration by {{fd|2.5}} seconds, up to its original duration.
R.description2: {{sbc|Overcharged:}} '''Zeri''' gains {{as|{{sti|15% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} and {{as|{{sti|30% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and an increased attack speed cap of {{as|{{ap|1.5+({{ccd|Zeri|as_ratio}}*0.3)}}|as}}. ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' is empowered to have a 20% shorter cast time and a decreased spread angle, and instead fires 3 rounds that travel with increased speed. The first round to hit an enemy per {{tip|cast instance}} chains electricity to the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy within 650 units of the target, up to 4 subsequent targets, to deal {{as|40% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}. This damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|40}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
R.description3: During ''Overcharged'', '''Zeri''' can generate {{tip|stacks}} of ''Hypercharged'' from enemy champions that last {{fd|2.5}} seconds. She generates 1 stack for each one she hits with an ability or ''{{ai|Living Battery|Zeri|charged}}'' attack, increased to 3 on abilities that {{tip|critically strike}}. Subsequent hits refresh the duration of ''Hypercharged''. ''{{ai|Burst Fire 3|Zeri|Burst Fire}}'' grants stacks only against the first target hit.
R.description4: {{sbc|Hypercharged:}} For each stack, '''Zeri''' gains {{as|{{sti|{{fd|1.5}}% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
R.description5: '''''Zeri''' can move during Lightning Crash's cast time.''
